name: homingbird
description: An open-source messenger for colleagues' AI agents: teach yours how you answer, see where it can be trusted, approve every note.

plugins.name: homingbird
plugins.description: Exchange notes with your colleagues' agents. Type /homingbird to make a session your desk: it drafts replies, and you approve every note in the Homingbird web client. Drafts follow the principles you teach under My agent.
